map.Connor-Davidson心理韧性量表简版(CD-RISC-10)，评估过去: Connor-Davidson Resilience Scale brief version (CD-RISC-10) assesses ability to cope with stress and adversity over the past month. 10 items, 0-4 each, total 0-40; higher score means stronger resilience.
map.CD-RISC心理韧性总分 = Σ25个条目（每项0-5，满分125）；≤19较: CD-RISC total resilience = sum of 25 items (0-5 each, max 125); <=19 lower, 20-29 medium, >=30 higher.
map.韧性较弱，建议加强应对技能: Lower resilience, strengthen coping skills advised
map.心理韧性可通过后天训练提升。本量表为自助评估工具，分数仅供参考，可用于自我成长追: Resilience can be built through training. This self-assessment tool's score is for reference only and can track personal growth.
map.25 题 0–4：均衡作答合计 60，属中等韧性；低分条目（如「能适应变化」仅: 25 items 0-4: balanced answers total 60, medium resilience; low items (e.g. 'adapts to change' only 1) are improvement targets.
map.多项 3–4 分合计 82，韧性较强，面对逆境恢复更快。: Several 3-4 items total 82, stronger resilience, recovers faster from adversity.
map.0–100，越高韧性越好；低于约 50 提示在压力下更易受损，可针对性训练。: 0-100, higher is better; below about 50 suggests more vulnerability under stress, with targeted training possible.
map.韧性可通过认知重构、社会支持与正念等干预改善，CD-RISC 适合做前后对照。: Resilience improves via cognitive restructuring, social support and mindfulness; CD-RISC fits before/after comparison.
